## Load reactome
```{r}
ensembl.react <- read.table("/home/flomik/Data/MOFA_R_Objects/Ensembl2Reactome_All_Levels.txt", header = F, sep="\t", comment.char ="", quote = "")
colnames(ensembl.react) <- c("ensembl.ID", "Path.ID", "URI", "Path.name", "Evidence", "Species")
ensembl.react <- ensembl.react[ensembl.react$Species=="Homo sapiens",]
```

```{r}
ensembl.react.m <- as.matrix(table(ensembl.react$Path.name, ensembl.react$ensembl.ID))
attributes(ensembl.react.m)$class <- "matrix" 
ensembl.react.m[ensembl.react.m>0] <- 1
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[rowSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0,]
ensembl.react.m <- ensembl.react.m[,colSums(ensembl.react.m)!=0]
```

```{r}
tmp1 <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)
tmp2 <- annot.df[grepl("^.*\\.p$", annot.df$feature),]
tmp1 <- as.character(tmp2$feature)[match(tmp1, tmp2$id)]
tmp1[is.na(tmp1)] <- colnames(ensembl.react.m)[is.na(tmp1)]
colnames(ensembl.react.m) <- tmp1
```

```{r}
res.react.prot.pos <- run_enrichment(mofa.sel, view = "Proteomics", feature.sets = ensembl.react.m, sign = "positive")
```

```{r}
keep_top_rows_df <- function(df,n_top=5) {
  # Create a new data frame with NA values
  df_new <- data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = ncol(df), nrow = nrow(df)))
  rownames(df_new) <- rownames(df)
  colnames(df_new) <- colnames(df)
  
  # Loop through each column
  for (i in 1:ncol(df)) {
    # Select the top 5 rows for the current column
    top_rows <- order(df[, i], decreasing = TRUE)[1:n_top]
    
    # Copy the values from the original data frame to the new data frame
    df_new[top_rows, i] <- df[top_rows, i]
  }
  df_new <- df_new[rowSums(is.na(df_new)) != ncol(df_new), ]
  df_new[is.na(df_new)] = 0
  # Return the new data frame
  return(df_new)
}
```

```{r}
options(repr.plot.width=9, repr.plot.height=10)
p.values <- res.react.prot.pos$pval.adj
p.values <- p.values[, colMeans(is.na(p.values)) < 1]
p.values <- p.values[!rowSums(p.values>1e-15, na.rm = T) == ncol(p.values),, drop=FALSE]
p.values[p.values < 1e-30] <- 1e-30
#p.values[p.values > 1e-2] <- NA
p.values <- -log10(p.values)
p.values <- keep_top_rows_df(p.values,n_top=10)
col <- colorRampPalette(c("grey97","red"))(n = 100)


pdf("results/figures/heatmap_pathways_Tojo_positive_factors.pdf", height = 8)
pheatmap::pheatmap(p.values, color = col, show_rownames = T, labels_row = str_trunc(rownames(p.values), width = 40),
                   cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=FALSE,border_color = "#555555",fontsize =14,fontsize_row=14,fontsize_col=14)
dev.off()
```
## Pathway analysis
Reactome (v68) and the MSigDB C2 (v7.2) gene sets, using the positive and negative weights separately and the function run_enrichement, with default parameters

```{r}
reactome <- read.csv("processing/reactome_v68_matrix_file.csv", row.names = 1)
reactome <- data.frame(t(reactome))
reactome$Genes <- rownames(reactome)
reactome$ID <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, reactome$Genes, keytype="SYMBOL", column= "ENSEMBL")
reactome <- reactome[!duplicated(reactome$ID),]
reactome <- reactome[!is.na(reactome$ID),]
rownames(reactome) <- reactome$ID
reactome$ID <- NULL
reactome$Genes <- NULL
rownames(reactome) <- paste0(rownames(reactome), ".g")
reactome <- t(reactome)
```

set.statistic = c("rank.sum"),
statistical.test = c("cor.adj.parametric")
alpha = 0.1,
```{r}
enrichment.parametric <- run_enrichment(
  mofa.sel,
  view = "RNAseq",
  feature.sets = reactome,
  factors = "all",
  sign = "positive",
  min.size = 10,
  nperm = 1000,
  p.adj.method = "fdr",
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary_table <- data.frame(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj)
#summary_table[summary_table > 0.0000001] <- NA
summary_table <- stack(summary_table)
summary_table$Pathway <- rep(rownames(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj), 10)
summary_table <- summary_table[order(summary_table$ind, summary_table$values),]
summary_table <- summary_table %>% group_by(ind) %>% top_n(5,-values)
summary_table_pos_pathways <- summary_table[!is.na(summary_table$values),]
#write.csv(summary_table_pos_pathways, "processing/MOFA_table_nodes_reactome_positive.csv", quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
enrichment.parametric <- run_enrichment(
  mofa.sel,
  view = "RNAseq",
  feature.sets = reactome,
  factors = "all",
  sign = "negative",
  min.size = 10,
  nperm = 1000,
  p.adj.method = "fdr",
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary_table <- data.frame(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj)
#summary_table[summary_table > 0.0000001] <- NA
summary_table <- stack(summary_table)
summary_table$Pathway <- rep(rownames(enrichment.parametric$pval.adj), 10)
summary_table <- summary_table %>% group_by(ind) %>% top_n(5,-values)
summary_table_neg_pathways <- summary_table[!is.na(summary_table$values),]
#write.csv(summary_table_neg_pathways, "processing/MOFA_table_nodes_reactome_negative.csv", quote = FALSE)
```
